title: Uchuu no Kishi Tekkaman Blade: TWIN BLOOD
justification: AniList 2300 (OVA, 1 episode(s)) is AniDB 1033's special(s) S2 'Twin Blood', aired 1998-06-05, and AniDB lists MAL 2300 on AniDB 1033. The parent's patched mapping list places S2 on TVDB 81723 0x1 'Twin Blood', also 1998-06-05. AniList's own start date (1994) is not a TVDB or AniDB date.
